name: free-llm-api-hub
description: A continuously-verified dataset of free-tier and trial-credit LLM API providers for developers.

scripts.test: node scripts/validate.mjs && node scripts/check-links.mjs && node --test scripts/build.test.mjs scripts/explorer.test.mjs
scripts.check: node scripts/validate.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs && git diff --exit-code -- README.md data/providers.csv data/providers.yaml collections site/index.html site/sitemap.xml site/robots.txt docs/credit-programs.md CITATION.cff data/probe-report.json badge-verified.json site/badge-verified.json

comment: devDependencies are used only by `npm run og` (social image). The shipped site and CI have zero runtime dependencies. badge-freshness.json is deliberately NOT a diff-gate target (it is date-relative: the oldest age in days moves daily — see docs/architecture.md). badge-verified.json IS a target (deterministic per dataset). The generated-file drift target list in `check` must stay in sync with the 'Generated files must be in sync with the data' step in verify.yml.
